theorem QOU.Archimedean.wp1_tendsto_expNeg_quadratic {A B C : ℤ} {β : ℝ} (hA : A ≠ 0) (hβ : Irrational β) (hβ0 : 0 < β) (hroot : ↑A * β ^ 2 + ↑B * β + ↑C = 0) :
